text:
alex.sales: Quick run-through: Prospect 'NovaHealth' wants to upload vendor evidence into their procurement portal. They asked for SOC2 excerpt, ISO page, a pen-test attestation letter, and confirmation we won’t share raw scans. Also asked if they can run a credentialed scan during the two-week POC.
rita.se: We can provide: SOC 2 Type II cover excerpt (PDF), ISO 27001 certificate page + scope statement (redacted), pen-test attestation letter (signed) and a 1-page findings summary. We DO NOT provide raw vuln outputs.
henry.security: Authenticated scans are allowed only on isolated staging or dedicated POCs with an approved test plan, IP allowlist, and supervised window. No destructive or persistent account creation. Need NDA addendum and signed Test Authorization form.
maya.ops: Ops can provision a time-limited S3 presign or SFTP upload. If they insist on portal upload, we can generate a single ZIP with the allowed artifacts and deliver it via presigned link.
alex.sales: They asked whether these items are part of Dedicated/POC pricing or extra.
rita.se: Standard enterprise POCs include the basic evidence pack. Anything needing legal review, custom redaction, or supervised testing is billable via SOW. Typical small SOW for supervised auth-scan + redaction: $4k-8k depending on scope.
henry.security: Add to the checklist that pen-test attestation will state the date of the last external test and that findings were triaged; it will not include raw reports or vendor-supplied PII.
alex.sales: Please give me a one-paragraph note and a tiny checklist I can paste into their portal.
rita.se: One-paragraph: "We will provide a SOC 2 Type II excerpt, ISO 27001 certificate page and scope statement, and a signed pen-test attestation with an executive findings summary. We do not share raw vulnerability scan outputs or audit working papers. If NovaHealth requires credentialed (authenticated) scans during the POC, these are allowed only on a dedicated/staging endpoint with an approved test plan, IP allowlist, supervised testing window, and an NDA addendum; supervised test support is billable via SOW."
henry.security: Checklist (copy/paste):
```
- SOC 2 Type II: cover/excerpt (PDF)
- ISO 27001: certificate page + scope statement (redacted)
- Pen-test attestation: signed letter + 1-page exec summary (no raw reports)
- High-level network diagram (redacted; no hostnames/IPs)
- KMS & encryption controls one-pager
- Pre-scan requirements: test plan, source IPs, test window, scope (staging/dedicated), signed NDA addendum
- Delivery: presigned S3 link or SFTP; portal upload upon request
- Contact: alex.sales for SOW quote
```
maya.ops: I can provision the presigned bundle once I have recipient emails. evidence-bot: Ticket created: EVID-7682 (NovaHealth evidence request).
alex.sales: Sending now, will ask them for test IPs and preferred windows. Thanks all :raised_hands:
